scientific_question: At the unchanged 2A+2A^T exact-call budget, does the two-dimensional deployment-visible observation subspace spanned by the loaded-q8 exact lift h and its first exact normal residual n contain a field that satisfies every frozen v75 field, full-gradient, interior-gradient, and observation gate on every one of the 75 already-open Case 3 cells?
evidence_role: Post-open mechanism feasibility diagnostic on the already-open BLASTNet vitiated H2-air Case 3 only. Truth is permitted only to decide whether the fixed two-dimensional span contains a compatible field. This is not a deployable initializer, learned model, external validation, resource result, real BOST result, algorithm breakthrough, or paper success.

fixed_data_and_geometry.preprocessing: identical to v75; complete source bounding box, deterministic trilinear sampling, one-voxel outer support, supported-interior mean gauge, no amplitude normalization
fixed_data_and_geometry.observation_generation: identical frozen noise-free known nine-view straight-ray exact operators from v66-v75
fixed_data_and_geometry.artifact: the same three read-only loaded rank-8 geometry artifacts used by v73-v75

two_dimensional_span.candidate_observation: A x(c) = c1 p + c2 q

convex_oracle.normalization_reason: Normalize by the frozen truth or observation scale rather than the gate radius so a very small reference error cannot inflate every quadratic coefficient.
convex_oracle.primal_problem: minimize over c in R^2 the maximum of the eight convex quadratic g_j(c)
convex_oracle.feasible_witness: a finite c whose independently recomputed eight v75 ratios all pass and whose maximum normalized quadratic value is <= -1e-10
convex_oracle.infeasible_certificate: nonnegative integer weight numerators with a shared positive denominator and exact sum equal to that denominator; for the resulting exact rational simplex lambda, Q_lambda is exactly positive definite and d(lambda)=inf_c sum_j lambda_j g_j(c) is exactly greater than +1e-10
convex_oracle.dual_formula: Q_lambda=sum lambda_j Q_j; l_lambda=sum lambda_j l_j; k_lambda=sum lambda_j k_j; d(lambda)=k_lambda-0.25*l_lambda^T Q_lambda^-1 l_lambda
convex_oracle.dual_arithmetic: Convert every stored float64 quadratic coefficient and every integer weight fraction to Python Fraction and evaluate the 2x2 positive-definiteness determinant and dual lower-bound sign exactly.
convex_oracle.boundary_abstention_band: If neither a direct witness has max_j g_j <= -1e-10 nor an exact rational dual certificate has d(lambda) > +1e-10, return INCONCLUSIVE; do not clip the sign or relax a gate.
convex_oracle.primal_dual_gap_role: diagnostic only; a materially negative gap is INVALID_NUMERICS, while a positive exact dual certificate proves infeasibility without requiring a small optimization gap
convex_oracle.formal_solver: deterministic smooth-max Newton continuation plus projected dual ascent with multiple fixed starts
convex_oracle.independent_validator: must not import the formal v76 solver; it must rebuild h,n,p,q and all eight quadratics, verify a strict feasible witness directly or reproduce the exact rational simplex dual certificate algebraically

fixed_controls.observation_ls_solver: float64 eigendecomposition or pseudoinverse of the 2x2 observation Gram with rcond=1e-12

decision.pass_rule: all 75 cells have independently validated feasible witnesses
decision.fail_rule: at least one cell has an independently validated exact-rational positive dual lower-bound certificate
decision.inconclusive_rule: no certified-infeasible cell exists but at least one cell has neither a validated feasible witness nor a validated positive dual certificate
decision.if_pass: Only then authorize a separately frozen Case3 time-block study of fixed analytic controls and, if needed, a minimal observation-only two-coefficient predictor.
decision.if_fail: Close the span{h,n} route. Do not use a larger neural model to rescue this span.
decision.if_inconclusive: Improve only the numerical certificate or tolerance audit without changing the span, metrics, cells, or thresholds.

claim_boundaries.allowed_if_pass: The fixed same-budget two-direction field span contains a v75-compatible truth-aware witness on every already-open Case3 cell.
forbidden_if_pass: a deployment-visible coefficient rule has been found
